aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, pickup times and fewer repeated questions. Founder: Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software especially for food trucks and mobile catering businesses, helping them take online orders, manage pickup times, keep orders moving smoothly and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was made to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is made with fixed-address businesses in mind.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools built according to how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory that helps people find food trucks coming to their area, I spent time learning more about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks keep moving, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see pickup times your kitchen can really manage. The system calculates from each dish's preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop excessive pressure on my kitchen?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe's fee: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month} other {The first # months}} free, with all features.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You make a weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work at different places?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is neither a minimum term nor a notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance, and your access stays until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS and has no TSE. Ask your tax adviser how to record online orders in your POS.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a POS with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before the customer reaches the truck: they choose dishes and a pickup time, pay online or at pickup, and the order appears in your kitchen. A POS or card machine takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is a food truck ordering system?

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or fiscal year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time ahead of the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted by themselves — no need to confirm each order.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Put a buzzer number on the order when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your truck appears on HatchGrab’s public map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep certificates such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety in one place. We remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser in one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each date goes straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create event types with your own prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen display, and the only way to keep taking orders after the network goes.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a slot is full, customers cannot choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward returning customers with digital stamp cards — collecting and redeeming stamps happens automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Put items together into combos and offer add-ons at checkout to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp auto-reply, for Messenger and Instagram questions.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Front counter and kitchen — run several screens, all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins with the right access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the network goes, online orders stop, so customers cannot place orders you would not see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app keeps taking orders offline too; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance via Stripe when customers order online.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a final time for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Add what each dish costs and see what you actually earned at each event, not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and order page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website, or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You only review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers an SMS automatically once their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we add the dates, places and times for each week and event automatically.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out in one tap — it turns grey for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock number; it goes down as orders come in and shows sold out by itself once it runs out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone itself; no separate card machine needed.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a pickup time slot, which spreads the rush across the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders right at the counter, with payment on your own card machine.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Auto-reply to questions on WhatsApp about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and also on the card machine you already take payment with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You are in a new place every week, at different times, where the mobile network is weak or absent. HatchGrab was made for exactly that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the network goes, online orders stop by themselves, so customers cannot place orders you would not see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Make your Facebook and Instagram posts automatic
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Shorter queues, and food ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you this evening?” “What is there for dessert?” Even while you are driving to the spot or busy at the grill, WhatsApp gets an answer using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
